title: Scale a rect
prompt: Return the rectangle with both its position and its size multiplied by factor, as if the whole drawing were zoomed from the top-left corner of the screen.
signature: func solve(r: Rect2, factor: float) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(r: Rect2, factor: float) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(r.position, r.size * factor)
hint: The starter scales only the size. The position needs the same treatment.
solution:
func solve(r: Rect2, factor: float) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(r.position * factor, r.size * factor)
